fixture_origin: official initial hello, schema and recorded positions, or phase-derived counterfactual snapshots with individual geometry/state checks

cases.name: full_hp_low_energy_drop
cases.construction: Full HP, low live energy, landed safe reachable drop; no current incoming line.
cases.assertion: Drop benefit can be positive; full HP is not an automatic rejection.
cases.scope: individual counterfactual; phase-derived zone and within-config equipment

cases.name: full_hp_full_energy_negative
cases.construction: Same as D01, energy full, stat cap reached and next threshold remote.
cases.assertion: Do not gain utility from nonexistent healing/energy or uncapped damage bonus.

cases.name: threshold_crossing
cases.construction: Same geometry, cube counts 0/2/9/10/12 and +3 reward; derived size/stats and attainable upgrade counts.
cases.assertion: Count newly crossed cumulative thresholds, do not spend or reset cubes.

cases.name: capture_progress_contest_exit
cases.construction: Owner progress 2 s inside ring; second occupant enters; then self leaves; authoritative progress resets; reentry starts fresh.
cases.assertion: Freeze is not completion; old progress is not kept after empty/different sole occupant.
cases.scope: scripted state contract; no reactive history claim

cases.name: drop_loss_or_capture_event
cases.construction: Selected drop disappears; self HP/energy/cubes updated with drop event; variant disappears without own reward.
cases.assertion: Replan both; never grant local reward from disappearance alone.

cases.name: drop_safety_new_damage
cases.construction: Accepted safe drop, then new observed damaging lines/low HP; geometry unchanged.
cases.assertion: Goal reevaluates; resource priority cannot blindly override survival admission.

cases.name: phase_boundary_hold_shrink
cases.construction: Times shrink_start-.05/equality/+.05 and shrink_end; observed current circle already interpolated.
cases.assertion: Correct physical slack and DPS; no double interpolation.

cases.name: moving_center_route
cases.construction: Nested shifted next circle; endpoint safe now, overtaken during walk/capture.
cases.assertion: Reject or reprioritize before spending capture/loot time.

cases.name: zone_reentry_regen
cases.construction: Outside damaged event, then legal inside position and healing quiet window.
cases.assertion: Last zone damage delays regen; armor never discounts zone DPS.

cases.name: crate_hit_resets_regen
cases.construction: Inside zone, low HP, safe quiet state then hit event target crate ID.
cases.assertion: lastDealt clock updates; do not predict uninterrupted healing.

cases.name: live_upgraded_regen
cases.construction: Actual nanites/plating/armor/servos effects applied to self.stats and upgrade array with consistent cube thresholds.
cases.assertion: Read live rate/delay/armor/speed; do not use base values or apply armor to zone.

cases.name: energy_spend_delay
cases.construction: Low energy, lightning-ready vs cooling; grounded boost and airborne jet variants with live upgraded drains.
cases.assertion: Combined energy budget; no immediate regen credit after spending.

cases.name: actual_readiness
cases.construction: One opponent, live cooldown/reload/charge just below/equal/above decision horizon and off-axis torso.
cases.assertion: Nominal DPS does not certify ready damage; physical fire gates remain.

cases.name: inventory_swap_authority
cases.construction: Charging laser plus full slots and a nearby pickup; then accepted took/dropped events and fresh self weapons.
cases.assertion: No charged-slot drop; apply inventory once from authoritative observation; equip delay respected.

cases.name: offer_queue
cases.construction: Reward crosses multiple cumulative thresholds; sequential distinct pending offers then applied upgrade observation.
cases.assertion: Valid current index, no double-spend or treating pending as already-applied stat.

cases.name: skipped_observation_merge
cases.construction: Two or more official-shaped queued observations with hurt/hit/kill and sound/beam ages.
cases.assertion: Latest tick response retains bounded event credit; ages use elapsed time.

cases.name: event_cap_eviction
cases.construction: One early kill then enough later legal-shaped damage entries to exceed 64 merged events.
cases.assertion: Expose loss limit explicitly; do not call it engine-observed or scoring cause.

cases.name: recorded_regression
cases.assertion: Source-off identity and exact protocol/late/error checks.
